title: Timezone Conversion Methodology
overview: Timezone conversions adjust times between different UTC offsets. Daylight Saving Time (DST) adds complexity as offsets change seasonally in many regions.

methods.name: UTC Offset Conversion
methods.description: Convert times by adding or subtracting the difference in UTC offsets.

formula.name: Timezone Conversion
formula.expression: Target Time = Source Time + (Target Offset - Source Offset)
formula.description: Offsets are hours from UTC (e.g., EST = -5, CET = +1)

methods.name: DST-Aware Conversion
methods.description: Accounts for Daylight Saving Time changes which vary by region and year.

formula.name: DST Rules
formula.expression:
US DST: 2nd Sunday March - 1st Sunday November
EU DST: Last Sunday March - Last Sunday October
Many regions don't observe DST
formula.description: Rules can change - use timezone database

footnotes: UTC never changes for DST - it's the universal reference
Some zones have 30 or 45 minute offsets (India: +5:30)
